conflicts_notes: Official candidate guide limits voter-elected boards to Town Council, six School Committee seats, and three Stetson trustees. The Town Council school representative is appointed/ex-officio and excluded.

Town offices are supplemented by separately elected Raynham Center and North Raynham water-district commissioners/moderators. BR regional allocation is legally four Raynham seats, but current district roster does not safely distinguish those seats. Cemetery administrative metadata conflicts with the 2026 elected ballot structure.

Representative Town Meeting is 192 elected precinct seats with one explicit current vacancy. Current municipal Housing Authority appointment practice conflicts with current M.G.L. c.121B §5; no elected Housing Post is serialized pending legal/transition reconciliation.

General bylaws enumerate a broad elected slate. Current M.G.L. c.121B §5 reduces older four-elected-seat Housing Authority wording to three locally elected seats plus tenant/state appointees. Many post-2026 holder identities remain unresolved.

Current elected structure is Mayor, 11 City Council seats, eight School Committee seats, and one Northeast Metro regional-vocational representative. Mayor's school role and city Housing Authority local members are appointment/ex-officio exclusions.
